name: Burnham On Sea Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food and support. Based at Burnham Area Christian Centre. Open Tue 12-2pm and Fri 10am-12pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Sedgemoor District Council Allotments
short_description: Allotment sites managed by Sedgemoor District Council
description: Multiple sites across Burnham-on-Sea and Highbridge area. Plots available from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage sheds. Contact Sedgemoor DC for site details.

name: Brent Knoll Community Garden
short_description: Community garden with volunteer-run vegetable plots
description: Run by local volunteers on Brent Knoll recreation ground. Grows seasonal vegetables with surplus available to residents. Fresh eggs from on-site chickens. Open Sundays 10am-2pm.
